summary: Wave 97 (Legal updates v2.4/v2.2 + Suitable-For auto-population) tested end-to-end. Backend: all 24 pytest cases pass against the live preview URL — 17 toner-lookup parametrised cases (HP/Canon/Brother/Epson/Samsung), slug-tolerant 'tn 2280', empty-list fallback for nonexistent codes, 4 printer→toner lookups (P1108→CE285A, M226dw→CF226A, HL-2240D→TN-2280, LBP6018→925), and stats showing printers=700, toners=601. Frontend: /terms and /privacy verified live via Playwright on the public URL — 14/14 Terms checks pass (heading, Version 2.4 · June 2026, §9 flat referral fee 7%, §9 no referral fee on delivery, §9A heading + ₹350/₹100 default rates, §10 dispatch photo + 'No returns are accepted for any other reason', §11 'platform referral fee of 7%' with ZERO user-visible 'commission' on the page, §15 'limited to the referral fee actually received', and section order 9→9A→10), and 4/4 Privacy checks pass (Version 2.2 · June 2026, §7 'Logistics partners' item with exact 'buyer delivery addresses are shared with the fulfilling seller' wording, §15 'Delivery charges are passed through in full with no deduction.'). The four auto-suggest UI flows (toner single, consumable single, bidirectional printer→toner, bulk add) were verified by code review of the wiring in TonerModelSearchSelect.jsx (debounce 450ms, lastAutoRef guard, calls onSelect with printers), CompatibleModelsSelect.jsx (onItemAdded(label,{isFirst}) callback), SupplierDashboard.jsx (lines 1234-1273 wires both directions), ConsumableListings.jsx (lines 256-289 uses TonerModelSearchSelect with testIdPrefix='consumable-model'), and BulkUploadGeneric.jsx (lines 619-643 updateCell auto-suggest with bulkAutoSuggestRef dedupe + never-overwrite guard). Runtime UI verification of supplier dashboard was NOT executed — per iteration_71/test_credentials.md convention, no shared approved-supplier account exists and creating one requires a register→admin-approve→cleanup cycle that pollutes the real-user DB. Recommend main agent self-verify the four UI flows with a disposable account, or seed a long-lived QA dealer as discussed.

critical_code_review_comments: TonerModelSearchSelect.jsx auto-suggest effect (line 78) depends on [value, onSelect]. If a parent re-renders onSelect with a fresh function identity, the effect re-runs unnecessarily — but the lastAutoRef.current guard prevents duplicate network calls, so functionally safe. Consider wrapping parent onSelect in useCallback for cleaner re-renders.

BulkUploadGeneric.jsx bulkAutoSuggestRef keys are `${idx}:${typed.toLowerCase()}` — if the dealer deletes a row and a new row takes that idx, stale cache entries could prevent auto-suggest. Low impact (dealer can manually edit), but worth a reset on addRow/removeRow.

ConsumableListings.jsx:262 — `compatible_models: f.compatible_models?.trim() ? f.compatible_models : printers.join(", ")` correctly preserves dealer edits, matches the bulk-upload semantics. Good consistency.
SupplierDashboard.jsx is now 1535 lines (still above 700-line threshold flagged in iteration_71). Splitting recommended but not blocking.
